easyPrerequisites: Hostage Taker must be exiled by Wormfang Drake, and Abdel Adrian must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Abdel Adrian for its mana cost.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it exiles Wormfang Drake until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Abdel Adrian's ETB.
When Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, Hostage Taker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Hostage Taker enters, it exiles Abdel Adrian until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Hostage Taker's ETB.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Wormfang Drake is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it exiles Hostage Taker until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Wormfang Drake's ETB.
When Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
